notes.title: Version 0.2.1 - Enhanced Balance & Fun
notes.notes:
[b]Game Update: Enhanced Balance & Fun![/b]

We’ve fine-tuned the game to make your experience even more enjoyable!
This update introduces better gameplay balance, smoother progression, and a more rewarding overall experience.
Thanks to your valuable feedback, the game is now more fun, fair, and engaging for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support — and stay tuned for more updates!
